name: Handoff: Send Files to Users & Agents
description: Send a file to a user or another agent in one call and get a share link, no API key needed. Add expiry, max opens, human approval, agent-only audience, revoke and access logs.
author: Juel Uddin

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Share a file in one call and get a download link. Pass name and content_text (or content_base64). Works without an API key: if none is sent, a new account is created and its api_key is returned once; save it to revoke the link or read the access log later. Default link: anyone with the link, expires in 7 days.

name.description: File name with an extension. No slashes or control characters.

content_text.description: UTF-8 text. Pass exactly one of content_text or content_base64.

content_base64.description: Standard or url-safe base64. A data:*;base64, prefix is stripped. Example: aGk=

mime.description: MIME type. Inferred from the file name when omitted.

expires_in_hours.description: Hours until the link expires. Default 168 (7 days).

max_opens.description: Successful downloads allowed. Omit for no limit.

requires_approval.description: Default false. When true, downloads wait until the owner approves.

ref.description: Optional attribution label. Lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen. At most 64 characters.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Create a Handoff account and return an API key once. No Authorization header is required. Save api_key. On later calls send Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass api_key only if you cannot set headers. share_file can create this key for you. The key is a secret. Do not put it in a file you share.

agent_id.description: Optional label, unique across Handoff. Letters, numbers, underscore, and hyphen.

ref.description: Optional attribution label. Lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen. At most 64 characters.

tools.name: save_file
tools.description: Save a private file for this account. Pass name and content_text or content_base64. Returns the file id and metadata. Does not share the file. Requires your API key.

name.description: File name with an extension. No slashes or control characters.

mime.description: MIME type. Inferred from the file name when omitted.

content_text.description: UTF-8 text. Pass exactly one of content_text or content_base64.

content_base64.description: Standard or url-safe base64. A data:*;base64, prefix is stripped. Example: aGk=

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List this account's files, newest first, up to 1000. Use this to find a file_id before sharing. Returns metadata only, never bytes or download URLs. Requires your API key.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Create a controlled download link for a file you own. Use this when a person or another agent should fetch the file. The response includes url and token ONCE, plus expires_at and max_opens. Save the url immediately. Later status calls do not return it. When expires_in_hours is omitted, the link expires in 7 days. Download with GET on that url. Requires your API key.

file_id.description: File id returned by save_file or list_files.

audience_value.description: Required for agent: the recipient's registered agent_id. Example: their-agent

expires_in_hours.description: Hours until the link expires. Default 168 (7 days) when omitted.

max_opens.description: Successful downloads allowed. The next one is refused.

requires_approval.description: When true, downloads wait until the owner approves the grant.

audience.description: anyone_with_link: whoever has the saved url. agent: only the registered agent_id in audience_value.

tools.name: get_share_status
tools.description: Read an owned grant: token_prefix (not the secret), audience, approval, expiry, revocation, and open_count. Does not download the file and does not return the share URL. Requires your API key.

grant_id.description: grant_id returned when the share was created.

tools.name: approve_share
tools.description: Approve an owned grant that was created with requires_approval. Opens stay blocked until this succeeds. Requires your API key.

grant_id.description: grant_id returned when the share was created.

tools.name: deny_share
tools.description: Deny an owned grant. A denied grant stays blocked. Requires your API key.

grant_id.description: grant_id of the share to deny.

tools.name: revoke_share
tools.description: Permanently revoke an owned share. Later downloads fail. This cannot be undone and does not delete the file. Requires your API key.

grant_id.description: grant_id of the share to revoke.

tools.name: get_access_log
tools.description: Read the latest 1000 access attempts for an owned grant, including refused downloads. Use this to see whether a share was opened. Requires your API key.

grant_id.description: grant_id of the share to audit.

tools.name: fetch_shared_file
tools.description: Download a file from a share url or token. Use this when you were given a Handoff url and need the bytes. Honors expiry, open limits, approval, and agent audience. anyone_with_link needs no key. An agent audience uses your API key. Files up to 1048576 bytes return content_base64, plus content_text when the file is text. Larger files are not inlined: the error includes the byte size and tells you to GET the url. A successful inline return counts as an open. A file over the inline limit does not.

url_or_token.description: Share url returned by create_share_link, or the 64-character token.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file you own. The bytes are removed and existing share links stop working. Requires your API key.

file_id.description: File id returned by save_file, list_files, or share_file.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.description: List grants you own. Pass file_id to limit the list to one file. Returns grant_id, status, open_count, max_opens, expires_at, and audience. Does not return tokens or download urls. Requires your API key.

file_id.description: Optional file id. Omit to list every grant on this account.

tools.name: update_share
tools.description: Set when an owned share expires. expires_in_hours is measured from now. Example: 168 for 7 days. Does not return the token. Requires your API key.
